scheme_name: HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth

exit_load.value: Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 15 days.

tax.value: If you redeem within two years, returns are taxed as per your Income Tax slab. If you redeem after two years, returns are taxed at 12.5%.

objective.value: The scheme is seek to capital appreciation by investing in units of HDFC Silver ETF (HSETF).

sections.name: category
sections.title: Category
sections.text: HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is the Direct plan, Growth option of a scheme from HDFC Mutual Fund. Its category is Commodities – Silver.

sections.name: launch_date
sections.title: Launch date
sections.text: The launch date of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is 28 Oct 2022.

sections.name: registrar
sections.title: Registrar
sections.text: The registrar and transfer agent of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is Cams.

sections.name: stamp_duty
sections.title: Stamp duty
sections.text: Stamp duty for HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth: 0.005% (from July 1st, 2020).

sections.name: expense_ratio
sections.title: Expense ratio
sections.text: The expense ratio (TER) of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is 0.18% excluding GST and statutory charges, and 0.21% including them, as on 10 Nov 2026.

sections.name: exit_load
sections.title: Exit load
sections.text: Exit load of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth: Exit load of 1%, if redeemed within 15 days.

sections.name: minimum_investment
sections.title: Minimum investment / SIP
sections.text: The minimum SIP amount for HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is ₹100. The minimum first (lump sum) investment is ₹100. The minimum additional investment is ₹100.

sections.name: riskometer
sections.title: Riskometer
sections.text: The riskometer classification of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is Very High risk.

sections.name: benchmark
sections.title: Benchmark
sections.text: The benchmark index of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth is Domestic Price of Silver.

sections.name: fund_manager
sections.title: Fund manager
sections.text: The fund managers of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth are Arun Agarwal, Nandita Menezes.

sections.name: about_the_fund
sections.title: About the fund
sections.text: Investment objective of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth: The scheme is seek to capital appreciation by investing in units of HDFC Silver ETF (HSETF).

sections.name: tax
sections.title: Tax
sections.text: Tax on redemption of HDFC Silver ETF FoF Direct Growth: If you redeem within two years, returns are taxed as per your Income Tax slab. If you redeem after two years, returns are taxed at 12.5%.
